versions.description_html:
Who owns the machine data: the plant, IT, or the supplier? In this episode of the iFAKT series, we cover governance for industrial data: ownership, data contracts, quality rules, access models between OT, IT and suppliers, retention, and how Microsoft Purview fits in.
You will learn how to build a governance practice that plants actually accept instead of ignore.
Who it is for: Data governance leads, OT and IT managers, data architects and compliance teams in manufacturing.
